Multiple CSS selectors each exclude their matched elements

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{\"exclude_selectors\":[\".nav\",\"footer\"]}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<body><nav class=\"nav\">Menu</nav><p>Content</p><footer>Footer</footer></body>", options: _options)
print(result)
```
